title: Poppy JSON error
description: An error with a JSON body from an endpoint this protocol or an extension defines, such as conversations (spec 7.13) and Mediated Sign-In (4.7), including rate_limited (4.3) and extension_required (3.3). extension_required names the extension in extension, and direct_conversation_open names the open Direct Conversation in conversation_id (7.10). Unknown fields are allowed.
